rows.name: allowSetToValid
rows.desc: A flag corresponding to each layer-purpose pair. t if the layer-purpose pair can be set as valid; nil if the layer-purpose pair cannot be set as valid.

rows.name: allowSetToValidInSession
rows.desc: A flag corresponding to each layer-purpose pair. t if the layer-purpose pair can be set as valid during a session; nil if the layer-purpose pair cannot be set as valid during a session.

rows.name: valid
rows.desc: A flag corresponding to each layer-purpose pair. t if the layer-purpose pair is valid; nil if the layer-purpose pair is invalid.
